The '''Coyn system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Elrood sector/Legends|Elrood sector]], centered around the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Coynek]]. Since the Coyn system was the beginning of the [[Coyn Route]], it was often called the "Gateway to Elrood Sector."
